topic: Geometric Foundations of Linear Algebra: From Systems to Spaces

sections.title: Geometric Interpretation of Linear Systems
lecture_lines: Linear equations define constraints in our spatial world.
Imagine a robot arm constrained by these equations.
The intersection of these constraints identifies a pose.
animations: Animate two lines representing linear constraints intersecting. (Color: #FF5733)
Animate a stylized 2D robotic arm link structure positioned at the intersection. (Color: #33FF57)
Highlight the intersection point with a target marker. (Color: #FFFF33)

sections.title: The Inverse Matrix: Unpacking the Transformation
lecture_lines: Matrices act as transformations on a grid.
The inverse matrix functions as an undo button.
Singular matrices flatten space, losing original information.
animations: Animate a grid transforming into a deformed shape using a matrix. (Color: #FF5733)
Animate the inverse transformation map returning the grid to its original square form. (Color: #33FF57)
Show a line compressing into a single point to represent a singular matrix. (Color: #FFFF33)

sections.title: Column Space: The 'Reachable' World
lecture_lines: Column space represents all reachable transformation outputs.
Visualize this as a span of vector columns.
The cat's reachable movement defines its column space.
animations: Visualize two column vectors originating from the center. (Color: #FF5733)
Animate a shaded parallelogram surface sweeping between these vectors. (Color: #33FF57)
Animate an icon of a cat moving within the defined spanned region. (Color: #FFFF33)

sections.title: Null Space: The 'Hidden' Kernel
lecture_lines: Null space contains vectors mapped to the origin.
These are directions squashed into zero space.
Think of the security camera's hidden line.
animations: Visualize a transformation mapping a 2D plane onto a 1D line. (Color: #FF5733)
Show a vector in the null space collapsing into the origin. (Color: #33FF57)
Animate a security camera icon with a 'hidden' field of view line. (Color: #FFFF33)

sections.title: Synthesizing the Big Picture
lecture_lines: Invertibility requires a non-empty, unique space solution.
Null space collapsing points prevents perfect reconstruction.
Mapping these spaces defines our full system picture.
animations: Draw two circles representing the domain and codomain. (Color: #FF5733)
Animate points collapsing from the domain to the origin in the codomain. (Color: #33FF57)
Display the mapping relationship connecting the Column Space and Null Space. (Color: #FFFF33)
